summary: 8 applications have 3D massing models representing 30 physical proposed buildings and 50 components. Ten featured projects remain in the demo; two Guildford entries retain site outlines pending usable building plans.
method: Simplified source-plan outlines aligned approximately to City application boundaries. Reported metre heights are used where available; estimated or conflicting values are disclosed per component. Both map building layers use metres without height exaggeration, on flat ground.
limitations: Public-plan demonstration massing, not an approved or survey-accurate 3D model. Footprints are approximate traces aligned to public application boundaries; terrain, facade, balconies, roof plant and exact stepped roofs are omitted. City validation and current drawings are needed before production.
Current development status, approved design revisions and selected RFP inclusion have not been confirmed.

22-0372 podium count differs between report and plan; clarification required.
Different roof levels are collapsed to one maximum height. Appearance is simple untextured massing, not architectural reconstruction.
23-0085-00 depicts the submitted148m Fleetwood scheme; the source report recommends referral for refinement, so it must not be described as approved.
New floor-area fields describe proposed project totals in City reports; they do not establish space currently available for purchase or lease.

23-0041-00 has differing heights within its source report: PDF p. 5 gives 117m/21m, while the proposed zoning table on p. 11 gives 118m/22m. The demo uses the latter. Verify against current drawings before production.

projects.name: Regency Gardens / City Centre 105A Avenue
projects.drawing: Site Plan, sheet 18, revised 12 February 2026; Development Statistics, sheet 4; Parcelization, sheet 3 (PDF p.20)
projects.height_method: Tower heights use report p.5 proposed maxima in metres: A145, C80, E130, F75, G101, H63, J50. PDF p.21 tower heights are each 2 m lower; this unresolved source discrepancy is explicit in every tower height_basis. Five six-storey woodframe midrises use the 19.5 m value expressly stated on p.21. Labelled lower podium/wing components use p.21 nominal values: 6 storeys/18 m, 8/25 m, 2/6 m. No height conversion estimates are used.
projects.geometric_method: Hand trace simplified exterior mass outlines from p.33 resized to 1780 x 1376 px, using p.21 for building/lot identification and p.20 to identify original vs dedicated property lines. Four-corner image-to-unit-square projective mapping followed by bilinear interpolation between corresponding WGS84 corners of City application polygon. Podium polygons subtract physical building traces; no tower/wing mass is stacked or counted twice.
limitations: No survey georeferencing or terrain corrections. Site-plan corner selection and traces are approximate.
Final architectural details are subject to separate Detailed Development Permits for each phase (report PDF pp.13-14).
Some small podium recesses, the ambiguous east base extension of A, facade overhangs, balconies and roof plant are omitted.
Twelve labelled physical buildings A-L are represented once; nine additional features are lower wings belonging to their associated towers.
